headline: India examining request to extradite Sheikh Hasina
summary: The Indian government has informed its parliamentary committee that it is reviewing Bangladesh's request to return the ousted leader.
details: The Indian government is currently reviewing a request from Bangladesh to extradite former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who has been residing in India since being ousted in August 2024.
This update was provided to the parliamentary committee on foreign affairs, chaired by Shashi Tharoor, in a report presented to the Lok Sabha on Thursday.
The report, titled 'The Future of India-Bangladesh Relations,' states that the request is being examined by relevant authorities in accordance with existing laws and established procedures.

The parliamentary committee had previously sought clarification from the government regarding the progress of the review after Bangladesh requested her return following a death sentence being issued in her absence.
India has maintained that Sheikh Hasina was granted asylum based on India's humanitarian tradition and civilizational values for those facing extreme crisis or existential threats.
The Indian government has also clarified that she has not been provided any political platform or allowed to use Indian soil to conduct political activities against another country.
Despite these claims, reports indicate that Sheikh Hasina has been conducting virtual meetings with party leaders and giving interviews to various media outlets while in India.

The parliamentary committee has recommended that the Indian government maintain a principled and humanitarian position while handling the situation with sensitivity and in line with international responsibilities.

headline: Sarjis Alam and others among 50 accused in Habiganj case
summary: Chhatra Dal has filed a complaint against National Citizen Party (NCP) leaders for allegedly attacking their members and snatching mobile phones.
details: A case has been filed in Habiganj against National Citizen Party (NCP) leader Nasiruddin Patwari, Sarjis Alam, and seven others, along with 40-50 unidentified individuals.
The complaint was lodged on Thursday night at the Habiganj Sadar Model Police Station by Iqbal Hossain, Joint General Secretary of the district Chhatra Dal.
According to the FIR, a group of 40 to 50 people led by Nasiruddin Patwari and Sarjis Alam attacked Chhatra Dal activists on Tuesday near the Court Mosque in the city.
The activists were gathered there to meet the family of martyr Ripon Sheel and attend a mourning meeting. Several mobile phones were allegedly snatched during the clash.
This follows a separate incident on Tuesday where NCP leaders were attacked while returning to the Circuit House after a rally and procession in Habiganj.
In response to that earlier attack, the NCP had filed a counter-case naming the district Chhatra Dal president and 11 others, along with 100 unidentified persons.
